GlobularModels.selection: Only ATNF-associated compact hosts with tidal radius <=500 pc and relative distance error <=0.2

MCXC-II.selection: All entries searchable; map only S/SP redshift types and z>=.002. M500 is an extended aperture mass, not a point mass.

SDSS-Superclusters.selection: Main sample adaptive threshold only; centre of mass RA2/DE2/Dist2. Edge/confidence retained.

SDSS-Filaments.selection: All observed filaments and all source spine points; no mock galaxies/fictional geometry. Independent sky-coordinate validation stored in audit.

SDSS-Voids.selection: Observed DR7 Type1 comoving catalogues, one tracer sample per nonoverlapping redshift interval; Type2/basic and other segmentation versions excluded. Edge flags retained. DR11 archive unavailable, not imported.

Cosmicflows-4.selection: All individual table2 distance moduli; corrected 2023/CDS release, not flawed August 2022 tables. Relative upper/lower distance error >50% retained atlas-only.

Nearby-Galaxies.selection: All objects searchable. Membership-only, Hubble-only and untyped txt distances atlas-only; individual measured/model distances eligible. Holmberg angular sizes retained.

GLADE+.selection: Explicit subset of full 23-million-row source: Type G, B<=15.5, f_dL=3 (spectroscopic), zhelio>.002. Other rows not claimed imported; no photometric redshift placement.

Gaia-Clusters.selection: Updated 2024 J/A+A/686/A42, Type o/m/g/d only, CST>=5 and CMDCl50>=.5. Rejected r types excluded; distant d retained without a bound/unbound claim; reported distance error >50% atlas-only. Not all Gaia stars.
